title: A missense mutation: sickle cell
caption: GAG becomes GTG at the sixth amino acid of the β-globin chain, replacing glutamate with valine. One different amino acid is enough to make haemoglobin form fibres in low oxygen.
alt: The start of the beta-globin coding strand and the same sequence with the seventh codon changed from GAG to GTG; glutamate is replaced by valine.
description: GTG codes for valine: one amino acid is replaced.
This is the change in sickle cell anaemia.
